// Executes Go chat templates with the Ollama fork's template engine (scratch check).
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"github.com/ollama/ollama/api"
	"github.com/ollama/ollama/template"
	"github.com/ollama/ollama/thinking"
)

type caseSpec struct {
	Template string        `json:"template"`
	Messages []api.Message `json:"messages"`
	Think    *bool         `json:"think"`
}

type result struct {
	Rendered string   `json:"rendered"`
	Open     string   `json:"open"`
	Close    string   `json:"close"`
	Vars     []string `json:"vars"`
	Error    string   `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var cases []caseSpec
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	out := make([]result, 0, len(cases))
	for _, c := range cases {
		var r result
		t, err := template.Parse(c.Template)
		if err != nil {
			r.Error = err.Error()
			out = append(out, r)
			continue
		}
		r.Open, r.Close = thinking.InferTags(t.Template)
		r.Vars, _ = t.Vars()
		v := template.Values{Messages: c.Messages}
		if c.Think != nil {
			v.Think = *c.Think
			v.IsThinkSet = true
		}
		var sb strings.Builder
		if err := t.Execute(&sb, v); err != nil {
			r.Error = err.Error()
		}
		r.Rendered = sb.String()
		out = append(out, r)
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := enc.Encode(out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
